flags.message: Petitioner appears unrepresented on the provisioned docket: the Aug 26 2026 entry is a withdrawal letter from petitioner's former counsel and the snapshot carries no petitioner attorney block (only respondent's). I read this against the 2026 political transition in Venezuela and changes in control of PDVSA, which I hold from general knowledge predating the snapshot rather than from any provisioned document; it raised my dismissed/withdrawn tail and lowered the grant number modestly. Not a mis-provisioning; noted so the evaluator can see what outside context shaped the forecast.

Snapshot provenance note: the file is named 2026-09-18.json but the stored payload's own creation date is 08/28/2026, so the baseline reflects the docket as of late August. CourtListener's docket record (checked in forward mode) shows no termination, so nothing indicates the petition has been acted on; I could not confirm whether new counsel has appeared for petitioner since Aug 26.
